programs.title: Moriah's Lighthouse
programs.desc: A woodworking artisan in a French seaside town dreams of restoring a local lighthouse, but an American architect may derail her plans.

programs.title: Love's Greek to Me
programs.desc: Ilana travels to the island of Santorini with her Greek boyfriend, Mike, for a family wedding. When he surprises her by proposing, she gets caught up in the whirlwind of his overzealous mom.

programs.title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
programs.desc: Katie helps plan her brother's proposal atop Machu Picchu. When the proposal is ruined by spontaneous Chef Carlos, Katie enlists Carlos to help her find the most romantic spot in all of Peru.

programs.title: Love on the Right Course
programs.desc: A professional golfer suffers a series of setbacks and returns home to Budapest to reevaluate her future. While there, a golf pro helps her rediscover herself and find love.

programs.title: A Little Park Music
programs.desc: When a piano appears in the park gazebo, interfering with important work, city manager Allie joins forces with rookie cop Ryan to remove it, only to find both music and love are hard to resist. Stars Laci J Mailey, Beau Mirchoff.

programs.title: Make Me a Match
programs.desc: Vivi enlists the help of matchmaker Raina to change her fate in love. However, Raina's son, Bhumesh, may just be the change she needed all along.
